what: blaze does not build with --features llvm (cargo build -p blaze-engine --bin blaze --features llvm, .coord-1030/b2-build/hello12-build.log): crates/hir-ty-codegen/llvm/release.rs:706 calls context.custom_width_int_type(u32::from(bits)).const_int(..), the old inkwell API; it now takes NonZero<u32> and returns Result (E0308 + E0599). lower.rs:830 and 2200 already use the new form. hello needs this: without llvm, hello11 refuses 238 functions because std is compiled at O3 which only LLVM does.
